import os


def render(writer, buffer):
    if os.environ.get("ENGINE_DEBUG_BUFFERS") == "1":
        stats = writer.buffer_stats()
        print(
            "render: %d objects, %d bytes written, high-water %d, "
            "buffer capacity %d"
            % (
                len(writer.objects),
                stats["length"],
                stats["high_water"],
                len(buffer),
            )
        )
    return writer.getvalue()
